name: Quy Nhon beach
kicker: The yellow crescent in the center of the city
summary: Swim the yellow crescent in the center of Quy Nhon. The sand is a walk from the rooms, and the beach is free. Skip it only if you came for Kỳ Co, which is a different cove nearly 25 km away.
timeNeeded: 60 minutes on the portal. A beach day is longer.
getThere: A walk from the center if you sleep on the crescent.
heroCaption: The crescent from the hill: sand, surf, and the roofs along the beach
gettingThere: The portal header places Bãi biển Quy Nhơn in Phường Quy Nhơn. If you sleep on the crescent, the sand is a walk from the center. No minute count is printed.
Kỳ Co is not this beach. It is nearly 25 km away, and that page does not split the distance into road and boat.

legs.heading: From the crescent
legs.body: Walk. The portal does not print a minute count from a named hotel, and no hotel is a pick.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: Free on the portal. A chair or an umbrella is check on arrival.
